title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 NEAR KODRA E DIELLI RESIDENCE!
description_en: The apartment is located in a new building and has not been occupied before. It has a gross surface of 87.5 m² and is organized in a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The property has regular mortgage documentation and is sold partially furnished. The residence offers peace, security and clean air. For more information, please contact me!
